Hi Aisha,

We’re finalizing the renewal and an upsell to increase our reserved capacity ahead of our product launch. Renewal window is Aug 15. Procurement needs the billing contact, Redwood's current W-9, and confirmation that Redwood will accept a PO for the full renewal amount under Net60 terms.

Can you confirm:
- Best accounts payable email to receive the signed PO?
- Redwood W-9 so we can attach to our finance system?
- Whether Net60 is acceptable for this renewal and the expanded capacity?

We plan to issue the PO this week if the terms are agreed so payment can be scheduled. Attaching a draft PO for your review.

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the details and the draft PO. We can absolutely support the renewal and the capacity increase. Quick answers up front:
- Please send the signed PO to billing@cedarlabs.com and copy nina.patel@cedarlabs.com.
- I have attached our W-9 for your records (Redwood_W9.pdf).
- We can accommodate Net60 for this renewal and the upsell; we typically default to Net30 but will make an exception given the enterprise commitment and capacity increase.

Next steps I propose:
1) You return the signed PO with an assigned PO number and final total.
2) I will route materials to our Billing Ops team to issue an invoice reflecting Net60 and proration for the capacity increase.
3) Vivek will confirm the invoice will be sent to the AP email you provided and cc finance@redwood.com.

Sending the W-9 and a short proforma so you can confirm totals before we generate the official invoice.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
